{{Quote|It's an environmental defense system.|Han Solo|<ref name="Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref>}}
A '''skirmish''' occurred in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Woteba]] when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], along with [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], attempted to combat at [[Fizz (acid)|Fizz]] problem by tracking down five smugglers, one [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] and four [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], whom trade starship fuel to members of the [[Gorog|Dark Nest]] for star amber.
